**seamark 3.0.1: what the tool tells you to run, it can run.**

A fix release on top of 3.0.0. Nothing about what `check`, `diff` or `seal`
resolve has changed; what changed is what the tool says to a reader.

**Install:** `pip install "git+https://github.com/marcosmatalab/seamark@v3.0.1"`, from the tag;
nothing is published to a package index. One runtime dependency (`cryptography`).

**Fixed:**

- `diff` ended a cause with "(run with --machine)", an option `diff` does not
  have. Every such hint now names `seamark check --machine`, and a test reads
  what `check` and `diff` print, every help page and both catalogues, and fails
  on any option or command the parser lacks.
- The catalogue carried 43 texts per language, left by the model scanner, that
  no code path reached and that named commands this tool does not have. They
  are gone.
- The Spanish catalogue writes its accents: `Qué ha cambiado`, `después`,
  `Idénticas`, `versión`. A test fails on the words that always carry one.

**Status:** Beta. 2,726 tests, 90% coverage, green on Python 3.11, 3.12 and
3.13.

**Verifying this release:**

```bash
gh release download v3.0.1 --dir . --repo marcosmatalab/seamark
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
gh attestation verify seamark-3.0.1-py3-none-any.whl --repo marcosmatalab/seamark
gh attestation verify seamark-3.0.1.tar.gz --repo marcosmatalab/seamark
git tag -v v3.0.1
```

`CHANGELOG.md` has the whole of it, under 3.0.1.
